reason: A cross-platform Tauri desktop wrapper that launches and displays the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, reuses existing local dsh data, supports tray operation, and performs background core updates.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 封装为支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 的原生桌面应用，提供托盘运行、本地数据复用和后台核心更新。
summaries.en: A cross-platform native desktop wrapper for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI with tray operation, existing local data reuse, and background core updates.

capabilities: Launches a bundled Node runtime and DeepSeek Harness web service
Renders a local web UI in a native Tauri window
Reads and reuses user data from ~/.dsh, including API keys, sessions, and plugin configuration
Checks an npm registry for updates and downloads updated dsh dependencies
Runs persistently in the system tray and enforces a single application instance
